newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Food Lion cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Food Lion cut.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Gary Giblen downgraded Food Lion Inc to outperform from buy, according to his office.

-- in a research note downgrading Food Lion Inc to outperform from buy, Smith Barney analyst Gary Giblen cited the company's reporting on Thursday its fourth quarter earnings of $0.14 per share, versus his estimate and the Wall Street consensus of $0.15.
-- said higher-than-expected operating expenses will continue, and cited frustratingly unclear timeframe on potential divestiture of the underperforming Southwest region.
